criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 6 and 9 come close to the showstopper test; frame 2's open tray holds at feed size. 7 reads as a flat chart with a lit row; 4 and 5 sit in the charcoal mid band and 5's neck needs its dek; 3 a straight-on plate tight under the dek; on 8 the pale floor takes more of the frame than the thin wire frame. The bench frames don't stand in a lit world the way the hall frames do.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck; cyan always a Vista node; one tray per node; frame 8's unlit trays a decision. 4 and 5 sit outside with a different grade and no tray; 6 and 9 near twins.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral checked traces to a quoted claim; the comparison hedged every time; two Xeons per node is one cited inference; HPCwire reposts of TACC releases with the reason stated. No hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened is clear, but no decider, no reason it touches a county, bill or institution, no step to take; closing question rhetorical; 4 and 5 teach biology a feed reader can't act on; the lab is unplaced.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Crisp cover ratio though 'nodes' is jargon; 3 and 9 restate it; the turn on 6 lands; 4 and 5 a detour; the close lands.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and honest; the caption's first line spends the feed real estate on hardware jargon; little Texas specificity; slide 5 and 7 read like a release.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Topic not in the window; palette and server hall fresh; count ratio cover and single scale unit relief familiar from 69 and 72.

one_sentence_fix: Lead the cover and first caption line with the plain result, and replace 4 and 5 with a sourced frame on how Texas researchers get time and help on Vista and Horizon.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Straight-on 860 grey cells read as a flat chart; the eight don't read as height.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Low three quarter under a hard key so the eight throw long shadows; field tops toward black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Neck ambiguous at feed size; charcoal mid band; SNAREs tiny.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop in on the neck so membranes and SNAREs fill a third; warm side light; near black ground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Same charcoal relief, SNAREs small; labels do the explaining.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raking side light, SNARE coils cast onto the bilayer, darker core stripes.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Straight-on plate tight under the dek reads as a diagram.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Carrier 120 px clear of the dek, 30 degree three quarter view.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Pale lit floor takes more of the frame than the wire frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Tighten the pool to the frame and its tray, let the floor fall to black, push in.
